001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.util.EnumMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.Objects;
006import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
007import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
008
009import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
010import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AbstractStandardEventFormatter;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.StandardEventFormatter;
013
014/**
015 * Encoder registry. Only one encoder is registered by default which has the URI schema of
016 * {@value AbstractStandardEventFormatter#SCHEMA} and is used if no encoder is found for
017 * the {@link OutputType} of the resolved output.
018 */
019public sealed interface LogEncoderRegistry extends EncoderProvider {
020
021        /**
022         * Registers an encoder by uri scheme.
023         * @param scheme encoder name.
024         * @param encoder loaded encoder
025         */
026        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder);
027
028        /**
029         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type.
030         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
031         * @return formatter for output type.
032         */
033        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType);
034
035        /**
036         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
037         * @param outputType output type.
038         * @param formatter formatter.
039         */
040        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter);
041
042}
043
044final class DefaultEncoderRegistry implements LogEncoderRegistry {
045
046        private final Map<String, EncoderProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
047
048        /**
049         * Creates encoder registry
050         * @return encoder registry
051         */
052        public static LogEncoderRegistry of() {
053                var registry = new DefaultEncoderRegistry();
054                StandardEventFormatter.builder().build().register(registry);
055                return registry;
056        }
057
058        @Override
059        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
060                var _ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
061                var uri = _ref.uri();
062                /*
063                 * TODO file bug with checker as it should have found scheme to be null.
064                 */
065                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
066                if (scheme == null) {
067                        throw new IllegalStateException("bug. uri was not normalized");
068                }
069
070                var provider = providers.get(scheme);
071                if (provider == null) {
072                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.ENCODER, scheme, uri);
073                }
074
075                return provider.provide(_ref);
076        }
077
078        @Override
079        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder) {
080                /*
081                 * TODO maybe check if one is already registered and do something?
082                 */
083                providers.put(scheme, encoder);
084        }
085
086        private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
087
088        private final EnumMap<OutputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder>> formatters = new EnumMap<>(OutputType.class);
089
090        /**
091         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type
092         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
093         * @return encoder for output type.
094         */
095        @Override
096        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
097                lock.readLock().lock();
098                try {
099                        var formatter = formatters.get(outputType);
100                        if (formatter == null) {
101                                return LogEncoder.ofTTLL();
102                        }
103                        return Objects.requireNonNull(formatter);
104                }
105                finally {
106                        lock.readLock().unlock();
107                }
108        }
109
110        /**
111         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
112         * @param outputType output type.
113         * @param formatter formatter.
114         */
115        @Override
116        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter) {
117                lock.writeLock().lock();
118                try {
119                        formatters.put(outputType, formatter);
120                }
121                finally {
122                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
123                }
124        }
125
126}
